title: The Shanghai Credit Corporation

page_data.en:
January 29th., 1944.
420
THE SHANGHAI CREDIT CORPORATION 21-1-44

Sir,

The Shanghai Credit Corporation at 947 Avenue Joffre
was established in June 1939 with Capital of $ 100,000.-
by three partners, namely:-
I.K. Mironoff, Chinese citizen. ( Died ).
K.A. Ovanessian, Chinese citizen. 685 Avenue Joffre.
M.M. Goldberg, Soviet citizen. 947 Avenue Joffre.
The capital of the Corporation was divided into three
shares and each of the partners held one share.
In March 1942 I.K. Mironoff died and his wife O.K. Mironova
became partner of the Corporation having received his share
in the business. In October 1942 Mrs. O.K. Mironova
contracted a serious sickness ( cancer ) and being unable
to continue her participation in the business of the
Corporation, sold her share for $ 50,000.- to Mr. G.L.
Schiffrin, Russian Emigrant ( Jew ) residing at 1173/1-16
Bubbling Well Road who since then is the third partner
of the Corporation.
The Capital of the Corporation has since been raised
up to $ 300,000.-
The Corporation is carrying out usual banking business
on a small scale.

（左侧批注：FILE）
（左侧签名：Miu）

1944年1月29日。
420
上海信用公司 1944年1月21日

先生：

位于霞飞路947号的上海信用公司于1939年6月成立，资本为10万美元，由三位合伙人组成，即：
I.K. Mironoff，中国公民。（已故）。
K.A. Ovanessian，中国公民。霞飞路685号。
M.M. Goldberg，苏联公民。霞飞路947号。
该公司的资本分为三股，每位合伙人各持一股。
1942年3月，I.K. Mironoff去世，其妻子O.K. Mironova继承了他在业务中的股份，成为公司的合伙人。1942年10月，O.K. Mironova夫人患上重病（癌症），因无法继续参与公司业务，将其股份以5万美元的价格出售给居住在静安寺路1173/1-16号的俄国流亡者（犹太人）G.L. Schiffrin先生，后者自此成为公司的第三位合伙人。
此后，公司的资本已增至30万美元。
该公司小规模开展常规银行业务。

（左侧批注：归档）
（左侧签名：Miu）
（底部印章：[模糊不清的方形印章]）
